newsitem.title: USA: Large cap techs show strength, boost Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Large cap techs show strength, boost Nasdaq.

text.p: Nasdaq shares recovered slim morning losses, finishing higher on the strength of Blue Chip technology stocks, traders said.

Nasdaq gained 10.76 points or 0.81 percent to an unofficial close of 1345.08. The Dow industrials jumped about 77 points or 1.10 percent to close officially at 7008. The long-bond slipped 6/32 to yield 6.65 percent.

"Techs recovered after some softness the last few days and this morning. The big names showed some muscle. But there's been such tech weakness in the last few sessions, so today's activity is not that surprising," one trader said.
Microsoft Corp rallied 5-1/8 to 100-1/8. Intel Corp gained 2-5/8 to 149. Dell Computer Corp added 1-7/8 to 73.
Read-Rite Corp gained 3-13/16 to 32 amid news that Applied Magnetics Corp proposed a merger valued at nearly $1.8 billion.
Vivus Inc was less fortunate, dropping 7-1/4 to 58 after a report in Barron's questioned the patient appeal and effectiveness of the company's MUSE anti-impotence compound.
